name: Fall and comeback
desc: A small, faded portrait of the hard times on the left; a large, warmly lit comeback portrait on the right. The turning point of a life or career.

CHARACTER.label: Person in the story
CHARACTER.default: an actor who went through great hardship in his career

BEFORE.label: Period on the left
BEFORE.default: tired, head bowed, in plain grey clothes

AFTER.label: Period on the right
AFTER.default: confident, upright posture, in a sharp dark suit

style.custom: Same person in two career periods. Smaller desaturated defeated portrait at left, much larger confident warm portrait at right, divided by a torn-paper seam. Do not confuse them with different people.

layers.name: Two-era atmosphere
layers.desc: Left half cold grey, dark and gritty; right half warm copper with gold spotlights; a torn-paper transition in the middle

layers.name: Hard times
layers.desc: {{CHARACTER}}, {{BEFORE}}, the same person in the past, black and white

layers.name: Breaking line
layers.desc: An irregular torn-paper seam separating the cold left period from the warm right period, thin light cream edge

layers.name: Comeback portrait
layers.desc: The same {{CHARACTER}}, {{AFTER}}, natural facial detail and a strong gold rim light
